points: Main camera and 3x zoom are close to a tie
iPhone handles hair edges better in portrait mode
Night photography got its own topic
answer.text: Samsung S26 Ultra wins on 10x zoom (it won the community battle), while the iPhone 17 Pro Max is preferred for portraits and especially video. Several people say a Pixel beats both at night.

desc: Side-by-side comparison of the two flagship cameras: zoom, night, portrait and video.
title: iPhone 17 Pro Max vs Samsung S26 Ultra camera
